title: A Local Agentic AI Framework to Generate Edge Case Scenarios for Safety Assurance
abstract: arXiv:2610.13479v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generating edge case scenarios is crucial for training, testing and safety assuring autonomous systems. This identifies hazardous failures to increase system reliability and robustness, ensures the system can still function safely on the boundaries of its operational design domain and learns the expected system behaviour for these edge cases. The rapid advancement in the generation and analysis capabilities of language models (LMs) has expanded their applicability and recent work has investigated LM scenario generation. However, many recent approaches rely on human-in-the-loop or rule-based strategies. This restricts the LM's ability to generate diverse and edge case scenarios; the long tail of the distribution. Our work uses local LMs in a laptop-based agentic AI framework for adaptive scenario generation. This is cheap, fully-controlled, ensures data privacy and security. translated_title: 一种用于生成边缘案例场景以支持安全保证的本地智能体AI框架
translated_abstract: 生成边缘案例场景对于自主系统的训练、测试和安全保证至关重要。这可以识别危险故障以提高系统的可靠性和鲁棒性，确保系统在其运行设计域的边界上仍能安全运行，并学习这些边缘案例下预期的系统行为。语言模型生成和分析能力的快速发展扩大了其适用范围，最近的研究工作已经探索了基于语言模型的场景生成。然而，许多近期的方法依赖于人在回路或基于规则的策略，这限制了语言模型生成多样化和边缘案例场景的能力，即分布的长尾部分。我们的工作在基于笔记本电脑的智能体AI框架中使用本地语言模型进行自适应场景生成。这种方法成本低廉、完全可控，并确保数据隐私和安全。它采用思考、行动、观察、更新和继续的循环机制（配合轻量级组件……摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于笔记本电脑的本地智能体AI框架，利用本地语言模型通过自主的“思考-行动-观察-更新-继续”循环自适应生成长尾边缘案例场景，用于自主系统的安全保证，同时兼具低成本、完全可控和数据隐私安全的优势。
en_tdlr: A laptop-based agentic AI framework using local language models adaptively generates long-tail edge case scenarios for autonomous system safety assurance, offering low cost, full control, and data privacy.
